Fairylands 使用说明

Fairylands 玩家手册。完整解压后打开 PCL-Fairylands.exe。

首次启动会自动生成 Minecraft 设置文件；中文设置由启动器初始化，画质可在游戏内调整。

下方保留第三方署名、许可及启动器修改源码；可展开阅读并保存原文件。

Fairylands 1.2.9 — HandShaker 客户端验包



已安装 HandShaker 7.0.1（NeoForge）和 HandLib 0.0.3（Minecraft 1.21.11）。

下载页另外支持 26.2、26.3，各自使用锁定的 HandShaker 与 HandLib 版本。

两者为上游原始发布 JAR，未修改签名或代码。



连接服务器时，组件发送已加载模组的标识、版本、文件哈希及校验组件签名。

上游组件也发送设备指纹哈希，其输入包括系统信息、处理器信息、计算机名与网卡硬件地址；

传输值为合成后的 SHA-256，并非这些字段的原始明文。有关信息已在启动器首页披露。



只安装客户端组件不会让服务器自动拦截作弊。

配套 Paper 插件及 Fairylands 专属规则单独放在服务端接入包内，尚未部署到线上子服。

它属于模组列表/版本/文件校验，不能替代飞行、加速、攻击距离等服务端行为检测，

也不能保证阻止修改协议、伪造报告或进程注入的攻击者。



来源：

https://modrinth.com/plugin/hand-shaker

https://modrinth.com/mod/handlib

https://github.com/IceVallish-Studio/HandShaker/tree/1.21.x

https://github.com/IceVallish-Studio/HandShaker-Core



发布状态：本次按要求未启动游戏或服务器测试。兼容版本以发布元数据和依赖声明为依据。
开始游玩.txt

保存原文件

PCL Fairylands 客户端 — Minecraft 1.21.11 / NeoForge 21.11.48



1. 将整个压缩包解压到独立文件夹，例如 D:\Games\Fairylands。

2. 双击 PCL-Fairylands.exe。首次运行请按启动器提示完成账号设置。

3. 点击“启动 Fairylands”。主菜单可选“单人游戏”或“多人游戏 · Fairylands”。



单人世界允许正常创建、加载和保存。多人列表预置 20 个 Fairylands 条目，地址均为 fairymc.cn。

多人连接仅允许 fairymc.cn；其他服务器、局域网连接、Realms 及其他目标的转移连接仍不开放。

连接使用默认端口 25565，并保留域名的正常 DNS/SRV 解析。

PCL 自动更新和更新提示已关闭：EXE 同目录下 PCL\Setup.ini 内 SystemSystemUpdate:3。

下载和启动仅开放：1.21.11 / NeoForge 21.11.48、26.2 / NeoForge 26.2.0.93、26.3 / NeoForge 26.3.0.95。

不开放其他正式版、快照、原版或其他加载器。新建版本单独存放模组，自动安装对应分支的 Fairylandsmod。

整包预装 1.21.11 和 Java 21；26.2、26.3 的游戏文件及 Java 25 按需联网下载。

启动时自动更新变化的 Mod；必需 Mod 缺失时尝试修复，修复或校验失败则停止启动。

更新清单验证 RSA 签名，每个文件核对 SHA-256；断网可校验并启动已完整下载的签名版本。

不限制玩家在其他独立启动器中另行安装游戏；本机文件可修改，不能视为不可绕过的安全边界。



登录方式由服务器决定：支持微软正版账号或启动器提供的离线用户名选项；若服务器要求正版，须登录拥有游戏的微软账号。整合包不含任何预设玩家账号或登录凭据。



已包含 Java 21、游戏文件、NeoForge、Fairylandsmod 及 15 个配套模组。

1.2.9 专属服务器访问限制；保留星空主菜单与圆角材质。包含 HandShaker 和 HandLib，报告范围见“反作弊组件说明.txt”。

首次使用仍可能出现 PCL 自身协议/提示和账号登录流程。

请勿只移动 EXE；Fairylands.PclGlass.dll、.minecraft 与 PCL 文件夹需要一起保留。建议预留 4 GB 磁盘空间。

启动器、主题模块与游戏版本需要一起保留；不要混用其他启动器可执行文件。



R：客户端设置；C：按住缩放；I：切换疾跑；V：切换潜行。

ESC：Fairylands 菜单、HUD 编辑器。长按返回大厅发送 /hub。

客户端设置 → 界面动效：开启/关闭游戏动画；PCL 首页 → 常用操作 → 减少毛玻璃效果。

游戏文件和配置：.minecraft\versions\Fairylands-1.21.11\

启动失败时请提供 PCL\Log1.txt、版本目录 logs\latest.log 和 crash-reports 中的报告。



启动器：PCL Fairylands 第三方美化版，基于 2.99.0.0（原作者：龙腾猫跃）。

按你的要求，仅编译和静态文件检查，未启动 PCL、游戏或服务器测试；显示、登录及进服由你验证。
界面与动画说明.txt

保存原文件

Fairylands 1.2.3



1.2.3 延续既有星空与玻璃样式，主菜单仅保留专属服务器和客户端设置两项主操作。

底部“更多”改为“辅助”，直接打开辅助功能设置，不再进入原版主菜单。

单人、服务器列表和 Realms 入口已关闭；游戏连接限制见 README 与开始游玩说明。

启动器关闭自动更新并保留 Minecraft 版本下载；没有运行界面测试。



以下为 1.2.2 的设计实现记录。



本次更新：

Minecraft 主菜单改为居中 Logo、操作面板和底部工具栏，保留真实功能入口。

去除“深蓝仙境”风格标签与多余标语；保留 fairymc.cn 地址和必要版本信息。

背景继续使用纯星空，并减轻主菜单底部暗色遮罩。

使用用户原始“仙境 / FAIRYLANDS”Logo，在 PCL 原生启动画面、标题栏、首页和游戏主菜单显示。

原始图像文件未重绘；显示时取有效范围，保持比例和像素风格。

正文 TTF 四倍采样，标题改为独立的大字形来源；不再放大小号字形。

PCL 按钮标签固定尺寸，按压只缩放材质；文字采用 Display 排版。

窗口阴影同步圆角，按钮外层透明、内层圆角裁切。



新增使用用户指定的 Liquid Glass Design skill：

https://github.com/xinlingfeiwu/liquid-glass-design-skill

选择 Media Glass Stage / Command Deck 的组合：星空内容层、居中主操作、独立命令栏。

Minecraft 使用圆角网格对星空纹理进行逆向边缘取样，中心零位移；

原生网格直接使用采样偏移，不需要网页 feDisplacementMap 的编码比例。

几何和偏移按尺寸缓存，上限 24 项；视差只更新纹理坐标；文字、Logo 和按钮标签不参与折射。

未采样桌面、游戏世界、其他窗口，也没有引入 Chromium/Electron。

主菜单玻璃材质可在客户端设置关闭，关闭后使用实色面板。

PCL 使用 6 DIP 模糊材质回退，不宣称具有游戏主菜单的折射效果。

用户要求不运行测试，因此没有执行该 skill 的截图或浏览器几何验证流程。



以下说明适用于既有功能，其中明确标注的历史版本仅作记录。



当前 PCL：Glass 苹果风格第三方美化版，首页源码为 branding/Custom-Glass.xaml。

保留第一版的简洁内容结构：品牌、启动按钮、服务器信息与快捷键说明。

顶部导航和左侧登录区使用窗口内背景取样毛玻璃；按钮统一圆角、焦点和柔和按压反馈。

正文卡片使用清晰稳定的浅色底，窗口不使用大幅插画或循环装饰动画。

原程序加入四处界面回调，加载 Fairylands.PclGlass.dll；离线与微软登录逻辑保留。

原作者署名及赞助入口保留，完整源码和构建脚本随交付提供。

首页“常用操作”可减少毛玻璃效果；低渲染等级或系统高对比度下材质回退为实色。

完整实现边界见 launcher-theme/DESIGN.md。本主题不是 Apple 原生 Liquid Glass。

旧的首页源码 Custom-Classic.xaml / Custom-Fairylands.xaml 作为历史素材保留。



继承的游戏功能：圆角使用浮点几何与屏幕像素级透明边缘；细化边框和过渡。

开关滑块与背景视差使用连续坐标；保留减少动态效果设置。

游戏：原创主菜单、直连 fairymc.cn、可搜索和分类的常用功能面板、平滑开关、

暂停菜单、公告平滑滚动、HUD 编辑器、原版菜单背景与按钮主题。

客户端设置 → 界面动效：动画、减少动态效果、背景移动、原版主题适配。

完整设置 → 界面模糊：强度 0–10，默认 4；原来的菜单模糊设置退出后恢复。

暂停菜单的“更多选项”保留原版进度、统计、玩家举报、局域网与服务器自定义入口。

公告可使用鼠标滚轮、拖动滚动条，也可 Tab 聚焦后使用方向键和 PageUp / PageDown。



性能取舍

界面动画依据经过时间计算，点击区域保持固定；主菜单仅使用一张背景纹理和少量星光。

公告换行在初始化或宽度变化时缓存；开关只在实际修改时写入配置。

不额外叠加 FancyMenu / Smooth GUI，以免与这些定制菜单产生重复过渡。

保留既有性能模组与 HandShaker 校验组件。没有进行帧率测量，不承诺固定提升幅度。



设计参考（仅参考布局、导航与交互思路；没有复制其品牌资源或代码）

HMCL：https://github.com/HMCL-dev/HMCL

OneConfig：https://github.com/Polyfrost/OneConfig

Modrinth App：https://github.com/modrinth/code

设计技能：已安装的 ui-ux-pro-max、redesign-existing-projects；

新增 Impeccable：https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable（Apache-2.0）。

已安装并应用社区 Apple Design skill：https://github.com/NutshellEngineering/apple-design-skill

参考 Apple HIG 的材质、按钮、动效与桌面交互规则；此 skill 非 Apple 官方发布。

启动器使用 Windows 自带 Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei UI，不分发 Apple 专有字体。



素材

背景：1672×941 深蓝星空，使用代码绘制渐变和稀疏星点；已移除浮空岛素材。

复现脚本：tools/prepare_starfield.ps1；固定随机种子、矢量绘制与超采样缩小。

无建筑、山体、岛屿或生成式插画元素。

现有“仙境 / FAIRYLANDS”标志沿用原项目资源。

界面字体：Google Fonts 的 Noto Sans SC，静态化为 500 字重并裁剪为拉丁及中日韩常用区段，

衍生字体更名为 Fairylands Sans，保留 SIL OFL 1.1 与原作者信息。

来源：https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc

字体复现脚本：tools/prepare_fonts.py；字体二进制已随源码和客户端提供，无需在线字体服务。



交付边界

按要求没有启动 Minecraft、PCL 或服务器做测试，没有运行自动化测试。

本次完成 Java 和 C# 编译、程序集装配及交付打包；实际显示、字体清晰度、登录、进服由你自行验证。

本次游戏 Mod 更新到 1.2.2，配套生成同版本服务端文件校验规则，未部署至线上服务器。



WPF 样式实现参考：https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/desktop/wpf/advanced/propertypath-xaml-syntax

属性路径与首节点依赖属性要求核对：https://github.com/dotnet/wpf/blob/main/src/Microsoft.DotNet.Wpf/src/PresentationFramework/System/Windows/Media/Animation/Storyboard.cs

with plugins, frameworks with development tools, and so on,
even if they're written in different programming languages
or for different computer architectures.  Goods and services

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Resources;
using System.Collections;
using Mono.Cecil;
using Mono.Cecil.Cil;

// Adds UI hooks and explicit Fairylands installation/launch gates to the pinned unsigned PCL assembly.
// The original executable remains the immutable input. No credentials are read or exported.
internal static class ApplyTheme
{
    static void BrandSplash(AssemblyDefinition assembly, string logoPath)
    {
        var app = assembly.MainModule.Types.Single(t => t.FullName == "PCL.Application");
        int replaced = 0;
        foreach (var method in app.Methods.Where(m => m.HasBody))
            foreach (var instruction in method.Body.Instructions)
                if (instruction.OpCode == OpCodes.Ldstr &&
                    string.Equals(instruction.Operand as string, "Images\\icon.ico", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                    instruction.Operand = "Images\\fairylands.png";
                    replaced++;
                }
        if (replaced != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected exactly one splash image reference.");
        var resources = assembly.MainModule.Resources;
        var existing = resources.OfType<EmbeddedResource>().Single(r => r.Name.EndsWith(".g.resources", StringComparison.Ordinal));
        using (var input = new ResourceReader(existing.GetResourceStream()))
        using (var buffer = new MemoryStream()) {
            using (var writer = new ResourceWriter(buffer)) {
                foreach (DictionaryEntry item in input) {
                    string key = (string)item.Key, kind;
                    byte[] bytes;
                    input.GetResourceData(key, out kind, out bytes);
                    writer.AddResourceData(key, kind, bytes);
                }
                // Preserve the user's PNG bytes. The native WPF splash retains its existing fade-out.
                writer.AddResource("images/fairylands.png", new MemoryStream(File.ReadAllBytes(logoPath)), true);
                writer.Generate();
                resources[resources.IndexOf(existing)] = new EmbeddedResource(existing.Name, existing.Attributes, buffer.ToArray());
            }
        }
    }
    static string Digest(AssemblyDefinition assembly)
    {
        var b = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (var type in assembly.MainModule.Types.Where(t =>
            t.FullName == "PCL.ModLaunch" || t.FullName == "PCL.ModDownload" ||
            t.FullName == "PCL.ModSecret" || t.FullName == "PCL.ModMinecraft"))
            foreach (var m in type.Methods.Where(m => m.HasBody && m.Name != "ThemeRefreshMain"
                && !(type.FullName == "PCL.ModLaunch" && (m.Name == "McLaunchPrecheck" || m.Name == "McLaunchRun")))) {
                b.AppendLine(m.FullName);
                foreach (var i in m.Body.Instructions) b.AppendLine(i.ToString());
            }
        using (var hash = SHA256.Create())
            return BitConverter.ToString(hash.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(b.ToString()))).Replace("-", "").ToLowerInvariant();
    }
    static MethodDefinition Method(AssemblyDefinition a, string type, string name, int count)
    {
        return a.MainModule.Types.Single(t => t.FullName == type).Methods.Single(m => m.Name == name && m.Parameters.Count == count);
    }
    static void After(AssemblyDefinition a, MethodDefinition target, MethodReference hook, bool instance)
    {
        var il = target.Body.GetILProcessor();
        foreach (var ret in target.Body.Instructions.Where(i => i.OpCode == OpCodes.Ret).ToArray()) {
            // Modify the existing ret so branches to it also pass through the hook.
            ret.OpCode = instance ? OpCodes.Ldarg_0 : OpCodes.Call;
            ret.Operand = instance ? null : hook;
            var cursor = ret;
            if (instance) { var call = il.Create(OpCodes.Call, hook); il.InsertAfter(cursor, call); cursor = call; }
            il.InsertAfter(cursor, il.Create(OpCodes.Ret));
        }
        target.Body.MaxStackSize = Math.Max(target.Body.MaxStackSize, 1);
        foreach (var ins in target.Body.Instructions.Where(i => i.OpCode.OperandType == OperandType.ShortInlineBrTarget)) {
            string name = ins.OpCode.Name.Substring(0, ins.OpCode.Name.Length - 2);
            ins.OpCode = typeof(OpCodes).GetFields().Where(f => f.FieldType == typeof(OpCode))
                .Select(f => (OpCode)f.GetValue(null)).Single(o => o.Name == name);
        }
    }
    static void Before(MethodDefinition target, MethodReference hook, int argument)
    {
        var il = target.Body.GetILProcessor();
        var first = target.Body.Instructions[0];
        if (argument >= 0) il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg, target.Parameters[argument]));
        il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Call, hook));
        target.Body.MaxStackSize = Math.Max(2, target.Body.MaxStackSize);
    }
    static void Gate(MethodDefinition target, MethodReference hook, int argument, bool returnsBoolean)
    {
        var il = target.Body.GetILProcessor();
        var first = target.Body.Instructions[0];
        il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg, target.Parameters[argument]));
        il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Call, hook));
        il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Brtrue, first));
        if (returnsBoolean) il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_0));
        il.InsertBefore(first, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Ret));
        target.Body.MaxStackSize = Math.Max(2, target.Body.MaxStackSize);
    }
    static void ReplaceVoid(MethodDefinition target, MethodReference hook, bool instance)
    {
        if (target.ReturnType.FullName != "System.Void") throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected a void UI method.");
        target.Body = new MethodBody(target);
        var il = target.Body.GetILProcessor();
        if (instance) il.Append(il.Create(OpCodes.Ldarg_0));
        il.Append(il.Create(OpCodes.Call, hook));
        il.Append(il.Create(OpCodes.Ret));
    }
    static void AttachVersionLoader(AssemblyDefinition assembly)
    {
        var method = Method(assembly, "PCL.PageDownloadInstall", "LoaderInit", 0);
        var instructions = method.Body.Instructions;
        var start = instructions.Single(i => i.OpCode == OpCodes.Ldstr && (string)i.Operand == "关闭下载");
        var constructor = instructions.Skip(instructions.IndexOf(start)).Single(i =>
            i.OpCode == OpCodes.Newobj && ((MethodReference)i.Operand).DeclaringType.FullName ==
            "PCL.ModLoader/LoaderTask`2<System.String,PCL.ModDownload/DlClientListResult>");
        var removed = instructions.Skip(instructions.IndexOf(start) + 1)
            .Take(instructions.IndexOf(constructor) - instructions.IndexOf(start)).ToArray();
        if (method.Body.ExceptionHandlers.Count != 0 || instructions.Except(removed).Any(i =>
            (i.Operand is Instruction && removed.Contains((Instruction)i.Operand)) ||
            (i.Operand is Instruction[] && ((Instruction[])i.Operand).Any(removed.Contains))))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected download initialization control flow.");
        var loader = assembly.MainModule.Types.Single(t => t.FullName == "PCL.ModDownload")
            .Fields.Single(f => f.Name == "DlClientListLoader" && f.IsStatic);
        if (loader.FieldType.FullName != ((MethodReference)constructor.Operand).DeclaringType.FullName)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Minecraft version loader type changed.");
        // Keep PCL's page lifecycle, retry UI and finish callback. Only replace the
        // placeholder task with the same shared catalog loader that the callback reads.
        start.OpCode = OpCodes.Ldsfld;
        start.Operand = loader;
        var il = method.Body.GetILProcessor();
        foreach (var instruction in removed) il.Remove(instruction);
        VerifyVersionLoader(assembly);
    }
    static void VerifyVersionLoader(AssemblyDefinition assembly)
    {
        var instructions = Method(assembly, "PCL.PageDownloadInstall", "LoaderInit", 0).Body.Instructions;
        if (instructions.Count(i => i.OpCode == OpCodes.Ldsfld &&
            ((FieldReference)i.Operand).FullName.Contains("PCL.ModDownload::DlClientListLoader")) != 1 ||
            instructions.Any(i => i.OpCode == OpCodes.Ldstr && (string)i.Operand == "关闭下载") ||
            instructions.Any(i => i.OpCode == OpCodes.Newobj &&
                ((MethodReference)i.Operand).DeclaringType.FullName.StartsWith("PCL.ModLoader/LoaderTask`2")))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Download page is not connected to the shared Minecraft catalog loader.");
    }
    static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        try { return Run(args); }
        catch (Exception e) {
            Console.WriteLine("Attachment failed: " + e.GetType().FullName);
            try { Console.WriteLine(e.Message); } catch { }
            try { Console.WriteLine(e.StackTrace); } catch { }
            return 1;
        }
    }
    static int Run(string[] args)
    {
        if (args.Length != 5) { Console.Error.WriteLine("ApplyTheme original.exe theme.dll output.exe audit.txt logo.png"); return 2; }
        var resolver = new DefaultAssemblyResolver();
        resolver.AddSearchDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(args[0])));
        resolver.AddSearchDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(args[1])));
        resolver.AddSearchDirectory(System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeEnvironment.GetRuntimeDirectory());
        resolver.AddSearchDirectory(Path.Combine(System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeEnvironment.GetRuntimeDirectory(), "WPF"));
        // Dependency resources are ordinary public libraries embedded by PCL.
        // Extract only whitelisted library bytes for Cecil metadata resolution, never application settings.
        string depDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(args[2])), "metadata-dependencies");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(depDir);
        resolver.AddSearchDirectory(depDir);
        using (var original = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(args[0], new ReaderParameters { AssemblyResolver = resolver }))
        using (var theme = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(args[1])) {
            var resource = original.MainModule.Resources.OfType<EmbeddedResource>().Single(r => r.Name == "PCL.Resources.resources");
            using (var reader = new ResourceReader(resource.GetResourceStream())) {
                foreach (DictionaryEntry item in reader) {
                    string key = (string)item.Key;
                    if (!new[] { "MeloongCore", "MeloongCore_Wpf", "PCLCS", "Microsoft_Win32_Registry", "Newtonsoft_Json", "OneOf" }.Contains(key)) continue;
                    var bytes = item.Value as byte[];
                    if (bytes == null) continue;
                    using (var dependency = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(new MemoryStream(bytes)))
                        File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(depDir, dependency.Name.Name + ".dll"), bytes);
                }
            }
            if (original.Name.HasPublicKey) throw new InvalidOperationException("Refusing to modify a strong-named input.");
            string before = Digest(original);
            var type = theme.MainModule.Types.Single(t => t.FullName == "Fairylands.PclGlass.GlassTheme");
            Func<string, MethodReference> hook = n => original.MainModule.ImportReference(type.Methods.Single(m => m.Name == n));
            var entry = original.MainModule.EntryPoint;
            entry.Body.GetILProcessor().InsertBefore(entry.Body.Instructions[0], Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Call, hook("Install")));
            After(original, Method(original, "PCL.ModSecret", "ThemeRefreshMain", 0), hook("Refresh"), false);
            After(original, Method(original, "PCL.MyButton", "RefreshColor", 2), hook("RefreshElement"), true);
            After(original, Method(original, "PCL.MyRadioButton", "RefreshColor", 2), hook("RefreshElement"), true);
            var policyType = theme.MainModule.Types.Single(t => t.FullName == "Fairylands.PclGlass.ClientPolicy");
            Func<string, MethodReference> policy = n => original.MainModule.ImportReference(policyType.Methods.Single(m => m.Name == n));
            Before(Method(original, "PCL.ModLaunch", "McLaunchPrecheck", 0), policy("BeforeLaunch"), -1);
            Before(Method(original, "PCL.ModLaunch", "McLaunchRun", 1), policy("BeforeProcess"), -1);
            Gate(Method(original, "PCL.ModDownloadLib", "McInstallStart", 1), policy("AllowInstall"), 0, true);
            Gate(Method(original, "PCL.ModDownloadLib", "McModificationStart", 2), policy("AllowInstall"), 0, true);
            Before(Method(original, "PCL.ModDownloadLib", "McInstallLoadersGet", 1), policy("PrepareInstall"), 0);
            Before(Method(original, "PCL.ModDownloadLib", "McInstallState", 1), policy("AfterInstallState"), 0);
            Gate(Method(original, "PCL.PageDownloadInstall", "MinecraftSelected", 2), policy("AllowMinecraftSelection"), 0, false);
            Gate(Method(original, "PCL.PageDownloadInstall", "NeoForge_Selected", 2), policy("AllowNeoForgeSelection"), 0, false);
            After(original, Method(original, "PCL.PageDownloadInstall", "ReloadSelected", 0), policy("StyleDownloadPage"), true);
            AttachVersionLoader(original);
            ReplaceVoid(Method(original, "PCL.PageDownloadInstall", "ShowMinecraftVersionList", 0), policy("ShowSupportedMinecraftPage"), true);
            foreach (string name in new[] { "McDownloadMenuSave", "McDownloadMenuSaveServer" })
                ReplaceVoid(Method(original, "PCL.ModDownloadLib", name, 2), policy("RejectManualDownload"), false);
            foreach (string name in new[] { "McDownloadOptiFineSave", "McDownloadLiteLoaderSave", "McDownloadForgelikeSave", "McDownloadFabricLoaderSave" })
                ReplaceVoid(Method(original, "PCL.ModDownloadLib", name, 1), policy("RejectManualDownload"), false);
            BrandSplash(original, args[4]);
            if (Digest(original) != before) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unapproved core method body changed.");
            Console.WriteLine("Writing theme and explicit client-policy hooks.");
            original.Write(args[2]);
            using (var output = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(args[2])) {
                if (Digest(output) != before) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unapproved core method digest changed during serialization.");
                VerifyVersionLoader(output);
            }
            File.WriteAllText(args[3], "Input: " + Path.GetFileName(args[0]) + Environment.NewLine +
                "Untouched core digest (excludes explicit policy methods): " + before + Environment.NewLine +
                "Login, purchase, authentication and untouched launch methods preserved: True" + Environment.NewLine +
                "Hooks: Application.Main; ModSecret.ThemeRefreshMain; MyButton.RefreshColor; MyRadioButton.RefreshColor" + Environment.NewLine +
                "Policy: launch/install gates; exact three-version list; unsupported manual download actions disabled" + Environment.NewLine +
                "Download page: shared Minecraft catalog loader connected; placeholder task removed; finish/retry lifecycle preserved." + Environment.NewLine +
                "Splash: Application image reference and embedded images/fairylands.png; original PNG bytes preserved." + Environment.NewLine);
        }
        Console.WriteLine("PCL UI theme module attached.");
        return 0;
    }
}

param([string]$AnalyticsEndpoint = '')

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

$output = Join-Path $projectRoot 'build\pcl-glass'

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $output | Out-Null

$inputExe = Join-Path $projectRoot 'downloads\PCL-binary\Plain Craft Launcher 2.exe'

$expectedInput = '6B6E1260CB5A1D6A303855F1C60CAB3D0BC1AEBBA7E40A964180188B271E7386'

if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $inputExe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $expectedInput) {

    throw 'The PCL input differs from the pinned 2.99.0.0 release. Review compatibility before building.'

}

$csc = Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'

$wpf = Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\WPF'

$theme = Join-Path $output 'Fairylands.PclGlass.dll'

$baseline = Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\update-baseline.json'

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $baseline)) { throw 'Generate the signed update feed with tools/prepare_update_feed.py and tools/sign_update_feed.ps1 first.' }

$publicKey = Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\update-public-key.xml'

if ($AnalyticsEndpoint) {

    $endpointUri = [Uri]$AnalyticsEndpoint

    if (-not $endpointUri.IsAbsoluteUri -or $endpointUri.Scheme -ne 'https' -or

        $endpointUri.AbsolutePath -ne '/v1/events' -or $endpointUri.UserInfo -or

        $endpointUri.Query -or $endpointUri.Fragment -or $AnalyticsEndpoint -match '["\\\s]') {

        throw 'Analytics endpoint must be an HTTPS URL ending in /v1/events without credentials, query or fragment.'

    }

    $AnalyticsEndpoint = $endpointUri.AbsoluteUri

}

$versionSource = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $projectRoot 'tools\release_settings.py') -Raw

if ($versionSource -notmatch 'CLIENT_VERSION = "([0-9A-Za-z.+-]+)"') { throw 'Missing launcher version.' }

$analyticsVersion = $Matches[1]

$analyticsBuild = Join-Path $output 'AnalyticsBuild.cs'

$loadingTheme = Join-Path $projectRoot 'branding\early-loading\theme-fairylands.json'

$loadingLogo = Join-Path $projectRoot 'src\main\resources\assets\fairylandsmod\textures\gui\mod_settings.png'

$loadingNight = Join-Path $projectRoot 'branding\assets\fairylands-night.png'

[IO.File]::WriteAllText($analyticsBuild, ('namespace Fairylands.PclGlass { internal static class AnalyticsBuild { internal const string Endpoint = "' + $AnalyticsEndpoint + '"; internal const string Version = "' + $analyticsVersion + '"; } }'))

& $csc /nologo /utf8output /target:library /optimize+ "/out:$theme" "/reference:$wpf\PresentationFramework.dll" "/reference:$wpf\PresentationCore.dll" "/reference:$wpf\WindowsBase.dll" /reference:System.Xaml.dll /reference:System.Core.dll /reference:System.Web.Extensions.dll "/resource:$publicKey,Fairylands.UpdatePublicKey" "/resource:$baseline,Fairylands.UpdateBaseline" "/resource:$loadingTheme,Fairylands.LoadingTheme" "/resource:$loadingLogo,Fairylands.LoadingLogo" "/resource:$loadingNight,Fairylands.LoadingNight" (Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\GlassTheme.cs') (Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\ClientPolicy.cs') (Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\UsageAnalytics.cs') (Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\EarlyLoadingBranding.cs') $analyticsBuild

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Theme compilation failed.' }

$cecil = Join-Path $projectRoot 'downloads\cecil\lib\net40\Mono.Cecil.dll'

Copy-Item -LiteralPath $cecil -Destination (Join-Path $output 'Mono.Cecil.dll') -Force

$patcher = Join-Path $output 'ApplyTheme.exe'

& $csc /nologo /target:exe /optimize+ "/out:$patcher" "/reference:$cecil" /reference:System.Core.dll (Join-Path $projectRoot 'launcher-theme\ApplyTheme.cs')

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Theme attachment tool compilation failed.' }

& $patcher $inputExe $theme (Join-Path $output 'PCL-Fairylands.exe') (Join-Path $projectRoot 'audit\pcl-glass-hooks.txt') (Join-Path $projectRoot 'src\main\resources\assets\fairylandsmod\textures\gui\mod_settings.png')

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Theme attachment failed.' }

Write-Output 'Built PCL Fairylands theme; launcher was not started.'

using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using Expression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression;
using System.Net;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Web.Script.Serialization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace Fairylands.PclGlass
{
    // Signed, exact-version deployment. This policy contains no GitHub credentials.
    public static class ClientPolicy
    {
        private const string Feed = "https://github.com/FairyMCDev/FairyClient-Releases/releases/latest/download/client-index.json";
        private static readonly object CatalogLock = new object();
        private static readonly object UpdateLock = new object();
        private static readonly string Root = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
        private static volatile Catalog catalog;
        private static DateTime checkedAt = DateTime.MinValue;
        private static string status = "正在检查 Fairylands 更新…";
        private static WeakReference statusLabel;
        private static string validatedDirectory;
        private static Build validatedBuild;
        private const BindingFlags Members = BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static;

        public sealed class Envelope { public string payload; public string signature; }
        public sealed class Catalog { public int schema; public long sequence; public Build[] builds; }
        public sealed class Build {
            public string minecraft; public string neoforge; public string modVersion;
            public Artifact[] files;
        }
        public sealed class Artifact {
            public string name; public string sha256; public long size; public string url;
            public bool required;
        }

        private static JavaScriptSerializer Serializer() { return new JavaScriptSerializer { MaxJsonLength = 2 * 1024 * 1024, RecursionLimit = 32 }; }
        private static object Get(object source, string name) {
            if (source == null) return null;
            Type type = source as Type ?? source.GetType();
            object instance = source is Type ? null : source;
            var property = type.GetProperty(name, Members);
            if (property != null) return property.GetValue(instance, null);
            var field = type.GetField(name, Members);
            return field == null ? null : field.GetValue(instance);
        }
        private static Type PclType(string name) {
            var assembly = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().First(a => a.GetType("PCL.ModMinecraft", false) != null);
            return assembly.GetType(name, true);
        }
        private static object Selected() {
            var instance = Get(PclType("PCL.ModMinecraft"), "McInstanceSelected");
            if (instance == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("请先选择 Fairylands 游戏版本。");
            return instance;
        }
        private static string Embedded(string name) {
            using (var stream = typeof(ClientPolicy).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name)) {
                if (stream == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Fairylands 更新组件不完整，请重新解压客户端。");
                using (var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8)) return reader.ReadToEnd();
            }
        }
        private static Catalog Verify(string text) {
            var envelope = Serializer().Deserialize<Envelope>(text);
            if (envelope == null || envelope.payload == null || envelope.signature == null) throw new CryptographicException("更新清单缺少签名。");
            byte[] payload = Convert.FromBase64String(envelope.payload);
            if (payload.Length > 1024 * 1024) throw new CryptographicException("更新清单过大。");
            using (var rsa = new RSACryptoServiceProvider()) {
                rsa.PersistKeyInCsp = false;
                rsa.FromXmlString(Embedded("Fairylands.UpdatePublicKey"));
                if (!rsa.VerifyData(payload, CryptoConfig.MapNameToOID("SHA256"), Convert.FromBase64String(envelope.signature)))
                    throw new CryptographicException("Fairylands 更新签名无效，已阻止使用此更新。");
            }
            var result = Serializer().Deserialize<Catalog>(Encoding.UTF8.GetString(payload));
            if (result == null || result.schema != 1 || result.sequence < 1 || result.builds == null || result.builds.Length == 0)
                throw new InvalidDataException("无法识别 Fairylands 更新清单。");
            var versions = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var build in result.builds) {
                if (!SupportedVersion(build.minecraft) || String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(build.neoforge)
                    || !versions.Add(build.minecraft + "/" + build.neoforge) || build.files == null || build.files.Length == 0)
                    throw new InvalidDataException("更新清单中的版本组合无效。");
                var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                foreach (var file in build.files) {
                    if (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(file.name) || file.name != Path.GetFileName(file.name)
                        || file.name.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars()) >= 0 || !file.name.EndsWith(".jar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        || !names.Add(file.name) || file.size < 1 || file.size > 512L * 1024 * 1024
                        || file.sha256 == null || file.sha256.Length != 64 || !file.sha256.All(Uri.IsHexDigit))
                        throw new InvalidDataException("更新文件信息无效。");
                    ValidateUrl(file.url);
                }
                if (!build.files.Any(f => f.required && f.name.StartsWith("Fairylandsmod-", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                    throw new InvalidDataException("更新版本缺少 Fairylandsmod。");
            }
            return result;
        }
        private static bool SupportedVersion(string value) {
            return value == "1.21.11" || value == "26.2" || value == "26.3";
        }
        private static Uri ValidateUrl(string value) {
            Uri uri;
            if (!Uri.TryCreate(value, UriKind.Absolute, out uri) || uri.Scheme != "https" || !String.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.UserInfo)
                || !uri.IsDefaultPort) throw new InvalidDataException("更新地址必须使用 HTTPS。");
            return uri;
        }
        private static HttpWebResponse Response(string url, int timeout) {
            var request = (HttpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create(ValidateUrl(url));
            request.UserAgent = "Fairylands-Client/1.2.3";
            request.Timeout = timeout;
            request.ReadWriteTimeout = timeout;
            request.AllowAutoRedirect = true;
            var response = (HttpWebResponse)request.GetResponse();
            ValidateUrl(response.ResponseUri.AbsoluteUri);
            return response;
        }
        private static string DownloadCatalog() {
            using (var response = Response(Feed, 10000))
            using (var input = response.GetResponseStream())
            using (var output = new MemoryStream()) {
                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                int read;
                while ((read = input.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length)) != 0) {
                    if (output.Length + read > 2 * 1024 * 1024) throw new InvalidDataException("更新清单过大。");
                    output.Write(buffer, 0, read);
                }
                return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(output.ToArray());
            }
        }
        private static void SaveAtomically(string path, string content) {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
            string temp = path + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
            try {
                File.WriteAllText(temp, content, new UTF8Encoding(false));
                if (File.Exists(path)) File.Replace(temp, path, null);
                else File.Move(temp, path);
            } finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
        }
        private static Catalog CatalogForUse(bool refresh) {
            // UI selection must not wait for a background HTTPS request.
            if (!refresh && catalog != null) return catalog;
            lock (CatalogLock) {
                string cache = Path.Combine(Root, "PCL", "Fairylands-Update", "client-index.json");
                if (catalog == null) {
                    catalog = Verify(Embedded("Fairylands.UpdateBaseline"));
                    if (File.Exists(cache)) {
                        try {
                            if (new FileInfo(cache).Length <= 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
                                var cached = Verify(File.ReadAllText(cache, Encoding.UTF8));
                                if (cached.sequence >= catalog.sequence) catalog = cached;
                            }
                        } catch (Exception) { SetStatus("忽略无效的本地更新缓存，使用内置签名版本。"); }
                    }
                }
                if (refresh && (DateTime.UtcNow - checkedAt).TotalSeconds >= 30) {
                    checkedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    SetStatus("正在检查 Fairylands 更新…");
                    try {
                        string text = DownloadCatalog();
                        var remote = Verify(text);
                        if (remote.sequence >= catalog.sequence) {
                            SaveAtomically(cache, text);
                            catalog = remote;
                        }
                        SetStatus("更新清单已就绪；启动时自动补齐对应版本的 Mod。");
                    } catch (WebException) {
                        SetStatus("暂时无法连接更新源，启动时校验本地已签名版本。");
                    }
                }
                return catalog;
            }
        }
        public static void Initialize() {
            // Resolve the bundled trust root before registering download/launch actions.
            CatalogForUse(false);
            Task.Run(delegate {
                try { CatalogForUse(true); }
                catch (Exception e) { SetStatus("更新检查失败：" + e.Message); }
            });
        }
        public static void BindStatus(object element) {
            var label = element as TextBlock;
            if (label == null) return;
            statusLabel = new WeakReference(label);
            label.Text = status;
        }
        private static void SetStatus(string message) {
            status = message;
            var label = statusLabel == null ? null : statusLabel.Target as TextBlock;
            if (label != null) label.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(delegate { label.Text = status; }));
        }
        private static string NeoForgeVersion(object versions) {
            var values = versions as IDictionary;
            if (values == null || values.Count != 1) return null;
            foreach (DictionaryEntry entry in values)
                if (String.Equals(entry.Key.ToString(), "NeoForge", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return Convert.ToString(entry.Value);
            return null;
        }
        private static Build Match(string minecraft, string neoForge, bool refresh) {
            if (!SupportedVersion(minecraft) || String.IsNullOrEmpty(neoForge))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("此启动器仅开放 Minecraft 1.21.11、26.2、26.3 的 NeoForge 专属版本。");
            var build = CatalogForUse(refresh).builds.FirstOrDefault(b => b.minecraft == minecraft && b.neoforge == neoForge);
            if (build == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("此 Minecraft / NeoForge 组合尚未发布配套 Fairylandsmod，请选择已支持的版本。");
            return build;
        }
        public static void ValidateInstall(object request) {
            var components = Get(request, "Components");
            Match(Convert.ToString(Get(components, "MinecraftVersion")), NeoForgeVersion(Get(components, "ModLoaderVersions")), false);
            if (Get(components, "OptiFineEntry") != null || Get(request, "FabricApi") != null || Get(request, "OptiFabric") != null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("专属版本使用配套优化模组，请勿混装其他加载器或 OptiFine。");
        }
        public static void PrepareInstall(object request) {
            ValidateInstall(request);
            // Each supported Minecraft branch needs its own mod directory.
            string folder = FullDirectory(Convert.ToString(Get(request, "InstanceFolder")));
            string settings = Path.Combine(folder, "PCL", "Setup.ini");
            var lines = File.Exists(settings) ? File.ReadAllLines(settings, Encoding.UTF8).ToList() : new List<string>();
            lines.RemoveAll(line => line.StartsWith("VersionArgumentIndieV2:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            lines.Add("VersionArgumentIndieV2:True");
            SaveAtomically(settings, String.Join(Environment.NewLine, lines) + Environment.NewLine);
        }
        public static bool AllowInstall(object request) {
            try { ValidateInstall(request); return true; }
            catch (Exception e) {
                MessageBox.Show(e.Message, "Fairylands 版本限制", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
                return false;
            }
        }
        public static bool AllowMinecraftSelection(object item) {
            string version = Convert.ToString(Get(item, "Title"));
            if (SupportedVersion(version) && CatalogForUse(false).builds.Any(b => b.minecraft == version)) return true;
            MessageBox.Show("仅开放 Minecraft 1.21.11、26.2、26.3，且必须已有对应的 NeoForge 专属 Mod。",
                "Fairylands 版本限制", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
            return false;
        }
        public static void ShowSupportedMinecraftPage(object value) {
            var page = value as FrameworkElement;
            if (page == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("无法显示专属版本列表。");
            page.GetType().GetMethod("ExitSelectPage", Members).Invoke(page, null);
            var panel = page.FindName("PanMinecraft") as Panel;
            if (panel == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("找不到专属版本列表容器。");
            panel.Children.Clear();
            panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock {
                Text = "Fairylands 专属版本", FontSize = 20,
                Margin = new Thickness(20, 24, 20, 8)
            });
            panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock {
                Text = "仅提供以下三个版本。安装配套 NeoForge 后，专属模组会自动补齐。",
                TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Margin = new Thickness(20, 0, 20, 16)
            });
            var entries = Get(page, "MinecraftVersions") as IEnumerable;
            if (entries == null) return;
            var create = PclType("PCL.ModDownloadLib").GetMethod("McDownloadListItem", Members);
            // VB's AddressOf inserts a narrowing sender conversion (Object -> MyListItem).
            // CreateDelegate alone cannot reproduce that relaxed delegate conversion.
            var callbackType = create.GetParameters()[1].ParameterType;
            var selected = page.GetType().GetMethod("MinecraftSelected", Members);
            var arguments = callbackType.GetMethod("Invoke").GetParameters()
                .Select(p => Expression.Parameter(p.ParameterType, p.Name)).ToArray();
            var selectedArguments = selected.GetParameters();
            if (arguments.Length != selectedArguments.Length || selected.ReturnType != typeof(void))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Minecraft selection callback signature changed.");
            var callback = Expression.Lambda(callbackType,
                Expression.Call(Expression.Constant(page), selected, arguments.Select((p, i) =>
                    (Expression)Expression.Convert(p, selectedArguments[i].ParameterType))), arguments).Compile();
            foreach (object entry in entries) {
                var indexer = entry.GetType().GetProperty("Item", new[] { typeof(string) });
                string version = Convert.ToString(indexer.GetValue(entry, new object[] { "id" }));
                if (!SupportedVersion(version) || !CatalogForUse(false).builds.Any(b => b.minecraft == version)) continue;
                object wrapper = create.Invoke(null, new object[] { entry, callback, false });
                var item = wrapper.GetType().GetMethod("Init", Type.EmptyTypes).Invoke(wrapper, null) as FrameworkElement;
                if (item != null) {
                    item.Margin = new Thickness(16, 3, 16, 3);
                    panel.Children.Add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        public static void RejectManualDownload() {
            MessageBox.Show("请在自动安装页选择 1.21.11、26.2 或 26.3，并安装配套 NeoForge。",
                "Fairylands 专属版本", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
        }
        public static bool AllowNeoForgeSelection(object item) {
            var entry = Get(item, "Tag");
            try {
                Match(Convert.ToString(Get(entry, "Inherit")), Convert.ToString(Get(entry, "VersionName")), false);
                return true;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                MessageBox.Show(e.Message, "Fairylands 版本限制", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
                return false;
            }
        }
        public static void StyleDownloadPage(object value) {
            var page = value as FrameworkElement;
            if (page == null) return;
            foreach (string name in new[] { "CardOptiFine", "CardLiteLoader", "CardForge", "CardFabric", "CardFabricApi", "CardOptiFabric" }) {
                var element = page.FindName(name) as FrameworkElement;
                if (element != null) element.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
            var button = page.FindName("BtnStart") as FrameworkElement;
            if (button != null) button.ToolTip = "仅支持 Minecraft 1.21.11、26.2、26.3 的配套 NeoForge 版本。";
        }
        public static void AfterInstallState(object loader) {
            if (Convert.ToString(Get(loader, "State")) != "Finished") return;
            string path = Convert.ToString(Get(loader, "Input"));
            if (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !Directory.Exists(path)) return;
            Task.Run(delegate {
                try {
                    object instance = Activator.CreateInstance(PclType("PCL.ModMinecraft+McInstance"), new object[] { path });
                    // Version metadata is resolved lazily by PCL when read below.
                    EnsureInstance(instance, true);
                } catch (Exception e) { SetStatus("游戏安装完成，配套 Mod 尚未就绪：" + e.Message + "；启动前会重试。"); }
            });
        }
        public static void BeforeLaunch() { EnsureInstance(Selected(), true); }
        public static void BeforeProcess() {
            // A second local check runs immediately before PCL creates the Java process.
            lock (UpdateLock) {
                var instance = Selected();
                string path = FullDirectory(Convert.ToString(Get(instance, "PathIndie")));
                var build = BuildForInstance(instance, false);
                if (validatedBuild == null || path != validatedDirectory || build.minecraft != validatedBuild.minecraft
                    || build.neoforge != validatedBuild.neoforge || build.modVersion != validatedBuild.modVersion)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("启动版本发生变化，请重新点击启动。");
                foreach (var artifact in validatedBuild.files.Where(f => f.required))
                    if (!Matches(Path.Combine(path, "mods", artifact.name), artifact))
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("必需 Mod 缺失或已被修改，已停止启动。请重新启动以修复。");
            }
        }
        private static Build BuildForInstance(object instance, bool refresh) {
            var version = Get(instance, "Version");
            return Match(Convert.ToString(Get(version, "VanillaName")), NeoForgeVersion(Get(version, "ModLoaderVersions")), refresh);
        }
        private static string FullDirectory(string path) {
            if (String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path)) throw new InvalidOperationException("无法确定游戏目录。");
            return Path.GetFullPath(path).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
        }
        private static bool Matches(string path, Artifact artifact) {
            if (!File.Exists(path) || new FileInfo(path).Length != artifact.size) return false;
            using (var stream = File.OpenRead(path))
            using (var sha = SHA256.Create()) {
                return String.Equals(BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(stream)).Replace("-", ""), artifact.sha256, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            }
        }
        private static void DownloadArtifact(Artifact artifact, string path) {
            SetStatus("正在下载 " + artifact.name + "…");
            using (var response = Response(artifact.url, 30000))
            using (var input = response.GetResponseStream())
            using (var output = new FileStream(path, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None)) {
                if (response.ContentLength >= 0 && response.ContentLength != artifact.size)
                    throw new InvalidDataException("下载长度与签名清单不符：" + artifact.name);
                byte[] buffer = new byte[128 * 1024];
                int read;
                while ((read = input.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length)) != 0) {
                    if (output.Length + read > artifact.size) throw new InvalidDataException("下载文件超出预期长度。");
                    output.Write(buffer, 0, read);
                }
            }
            if (!Matches(path, artifact)) throw new CryptographicException("文件校验失败：" + artifact.name);
        }
        private static string MutexName(string directory) {
            using (var sha = SHA256.Create())
                return @"Local\Fairylands-Update-" + BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(directory.ToLowerInvariant()))).Replace("-", "");
        }
        private static void EnsureInstance(object instance, bool refresh) {
            lock (UpdateLock) {
                var build = BuildForInstance(instance, refresh);
                string directory = FullDirectory(Convert.ToString(Get(instance, "PathIndie")));
                var process = Get(PclType("PCL.ModLaunch"), "McLaunchProcess") as System.Diagnostics.Process;
                if (process != null && validatedDirectory == directory) {
                    try {
                        if (!process.HasExited) throw new IOException("此游戏版本仍在运行，请关闭游戏后再更新或启动。");
                    } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
                }
                using (var mutex = new Mutex(false, MutexName(directory))) {
                    bool acquired;
                    try { acquired = mutex.WaitOne(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5)); }
                    catch (AbandonedMutexException) { acquired = true; }
                    if (!acquired) throw new IOException("其他启动器仍在更新此版本，请稍后重试。");
                    try {
                        ApplyBuild(directory, build);
                        EarlyLoadingBranding.Ensure(directory);
                        validatedDirectory = directory;
                        validatedBuild = build;
                        SetStatus("Fairylands " + build.modVersion + " 已就绪 · " + build.minecraft + " / NeoForge " + build.neoforge);
                    } finally { mutex.ReleaseMutex(); }
                }
            }
        }
        private static void ApplyBuild(string directory, Build build) {
            string mods = Path.Combine(directory, "mods");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(mods);
            string clientConfig = Path.Combine(directory, "config", "HandShaker", "config.yml");
            if (!File.Exists(clientConfig))
                SaveAtomically(clientConfig,
                    "settings:\n  config-version: 7\n  handshaker-enforcement: false\n  whitelist-enforcement: false\n"
                    + "  database: false\n  custom-lists:\n    mods-required-enabled: false\n"
                    + "    mods-blacklisted-enabled: false\n    mods-whitelisted-enabled: false\n");
            string options = Path.Combine(directory, "options.txt");
            if (!File.Exists(options)) SaveAtomically(options, "lang:zh_cn\nonboardAccessibility:false\n");
            var changed = build.files.Where(file => !Matches(Path.Combine(mods, file.name), file)).ToArray();
            // Only move files belonging to previously signed builds, never unrelated user mods.
            var managedNames = new HashSet<string>(CatalogForUse(false).builds.SelectMany(b => b.files).Select(f => f.name), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var file in Verify(Embedded("Fairylands.UpdateBaseline")).builds.SelectMany(b => b.files))
                managedNames.Add(file.name);
            var currentNames = new HashSet<string>(build.files.Select(f => f.name), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            string stateFile = Path.Combine(directory, ".fairylands-managed.json");
            if (File.Exists(stateFile) && new FileInfo(stateFile).Length < 1024 * 1024) {
                try {
                    foreach (string name in Serializer().Deserialize<string[]>(File.ReadAllText(stateFile, Encoding.UTF8)))
                        if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && name == Path.GetFileName(name) && name.EndsWith(".jar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            managedNames.Add(name);
                } catch (Exception) { }
            }
            string[] obsolete = Directory.GetFiles(mods, "*.jar").Where(p => {
                string name = Path.GetFileName(p);
                return !currentNames.Contains(name) && (managedNames.Contains(name) || name.StartsWith("Fairylandsmod-", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            }).ToArray();
            if (changed.Length == 0 && obsolete.Length == 0) {
                SaveAtomically(stateFile, Serializer().Serialize(build.files.Select(f => f.name).ToArray()));
                return;
            }
            string work = Path.Combine(directory, ".fairylands-update", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            string staged = Path.Combine(work, "staged"), backup = Path.Combine(work, "backup");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(staged);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(backup);
            var installed = new List<string>();
            var moved = new List<KeyValuePair<string, string>>();
            bool committed = false;
            try {
                foreach (var file in changed) DownloadArtifact(file, Path.Combine(staged, file.name));
                var moveOld = obsolete.Concat(changed.Select(f => Path.Combine(mods, f.name)).Where(File.Exists)).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                foreach (string path in moveOld) {
                    string saved = Path.Combine(backup, Path.GetFileName(path));
                    File.Move(path, saved);
                    moved.Add(new KeyValuePair<string, string>(path, saved));
                }
                foreach (var file in changed) {
                    string target = Path.Combine(mods, file.name);
                    File.Move(Path.Combine(staged, file.name), target);
                    installed.Add(target);
                }
                foreach (var file in build.files)
                    if (!Matches(Path.Combine(mods, file.name), file)) throw new IOException("更新后校验失败：" + file.name);
                SaveAtomically(stateFile, Serializer().Serialize(build.files.Select(f => f.name).ToArray()));
                committed = true;
            } finally {
                if (!committed) {
                    foreach (string path in installed) if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
                    foreach (var entry in moved.AsEnumerable().Reverse())
                        if (File.Exists(entry.Value)) File.Move(entry.Value, entry.Key);
                }
                // Keep rollback copies after success; they are outside mods and will not load.
                foreach (string path in Directory.GetFiles(staged)) File.Delete(path);
                Directory.Delete(staged);
            }
        }
    }
}

# Fairylands 启动器材质与交互

**目标平台：** Windows WPF。参考 Apple HIG 的桌面交互和材质分层，在现有 PCL 上实现，不使用 Apple 专有字体或系统框架。

**导航：** 保留 PCL 顶部导航、左侧登录/版本选择、右侧首页的操作位置。导航层采用模糊取样与浅色覆盖；正文使用稳定、较不透明的背景。主界面不再使用大幅插画或循环装饰动画。

**主内容：** 保留首版的品牌区、启动操作、服务器地址、常用操作与折叠说明。一个主色为蓝色，保持 PCL 对第三方版本的品牌要求。

**按钮：** 保留原 MyButton 及事件路由，在其可见表面下加入独立材质层。标签清晰，重要操作蓝底白字，普通操作深色文字。悬停和按压采用 180 ms 缓动，只有材质层按压缩放至 0.985，文字和点击区域不变。增加 Enter/Space 激活，沿用原按钮行为。外层背景透明，内层使用圆角几何裁切，避免露出矩形底色。

**材质：** VisualBrush 对窗口内独立背景层进行同坐标取样，再通过 BlurEffect 模糊；仅模糊底图，不模糊文字。按窗口缩放、布局位置更新取样。高光边缘、半透明白色覆盖和焦点描边彼此分离。它是 Windows 上的苹果风格毛玻璃实现，不是 Apple 原生 Liquid Glass 折射着色器，也不采集桌面或其他应用画面。

**状态：** 普通、悬停、按下、键盘焦点、不可用。加载进度和登录状态由原 PCL 继续管理，不伪造在线人数或完成状态。

**可访问性：** 文字优先，保留系统键盘习惯与清晰焦点。新增“减少毛玻璃效果”，读取 Windows 高对比度与动画偏好；低图形渲染等级退回实色材质。此开关控制新增主题效果，不替代 PCL 原本的全部动画设置。

**尺寸：** 主题圆角 12 DIP、窗口 18 DIP、内容卡片 18–22 DIP；这些是本项目适配值，并非宣称 Apple 对 Windows 的规定。原版控件布局与状态机保留。

**品牌：** PCL 原生启动画面引用替换为用户提供的 Fairylands PNG，并保留原来的渐隐关闭。标题栏和首页按原图有效范围显示 Logo，Minecraft 主菜单也使用同一原图；没有生成或重绘用户商标。窗口旧的分块阴影替换为与 18 DIP 圆角一致的阴影，缩放窗口的命中区域保留。

**实现边界：** 修改入口与三个 UI 刷新点来加载主题模块，另替换启动图片引用并嵌入原图。未替换微软/离线登录、正版购买劝导、赞助解锁、游戏启动、下载或服务器认证逻辑。编译工具核对关键模块 IL 指纹保持一致，不进行客户端运行测试。

## 设计来源

- 使用的社区技能：https://github.com/NutshellEngineering/apple-design-skill
- 用户指定的材质技能：https://github.com/xinlingfeiwu/liquid-glass-design-skill
- 材质：https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/materials
- 按钮：https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons
- 动效：https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion
- 字体与无障碍：https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/typography
- PCL 基础源码：https://github.com/Meloong-Git/PCL/tree/2.99.0.0
- WPF 材质绘制：https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.windows.media.visualbrush

技能为社区维护的参考资料，不是 Apple 发布或认证的技能。

1.2.2 将 Liquid Glass skill 的布局、前景清晰度和材质回退规则适配到原生平台。
游戏采用 Media Glass Stage / Command Deck 组合和逆向边缘取样，见 GlassLens.java；
PCL 采用 6 DIP 模糊回退，使用原生 WPF 控件，未移植 CSS/SVG 运行时。
按用户不运行测试的要求，没有执行 skill 的截图或浏览器验收步骤，运行视觉效果待用户确认。

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace Fairylands.PclGlass
{
    // Uses FML's documented config/fml theme override, without modifying loader JARs.
    internal static class EarlyLoadingBranding
    {
        internal static void Ensure(string gameDirectory)
        {
            string folder = Path.Combine(gameDirectory, "config", "fml");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
            Save(folder, "fairylands-logo.png", Bytes("Fairylands.LoadingLogo"));
            Save(folder, "fairylands-night.png", Bytes("Fairylands.LoadingNight"));
            byte[] theme = Bytes("Fairylands.LoadingTheme");
            foreach (string name in new[] { "default", "darkmode", "april-fools", "april-fools-darkmode" })
                Save(folder, "theme-" + name + ".json", theme);
        }

        private static byte[] Bytes(string name)
        {
            using (var input = typeof(EarlyLoadingBranding).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name))
            using (var output = new MemoryStream()) {
                if (input == null) throw new IOException("缺少 Fairylands 加载画面资源。");
                input.CopyTo(output); return output.ToArray();
            }
        }

        private static void Save(string folder, string name, byte[] data)
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(folder, name);
            if (File.Exists(path)) {
                byte[] prior = File.ReadAllBytes(path);
                if (prior.SequenceEqual(data)) return;
                string hash;
                using (var sha = SHA256.Create()) hash = BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(prior)).Replace("-", "");
                string backup = Path.Combine(folder, ".fairylands-backups", hash, name);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(backup));
                if (!File.Exists(backup)) File.Copy(path, backup);
            }
            string temporary = path + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
            try {
                File.WriteAllBytes(temporary, data);
                if (File.Exists(path)) File.Replace(temporary, path, null);
                else File.Move(temporary, path);
            } finally { if (File.Exists(temporary)) File.Delete(temporary); }
        }
    }
}
