using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Automation;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Animation;
using System.Windows.Media.Effects;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Shapes;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace Fairylands.PclGlass
{
    // Visual theme plus explicitly scoped client deployment policy; account and purchase flows remain upstream.
    public static class GlassTheme
    {
        private static bool installed;
        private static Window main;
        private static Grid scene;
        private static bool reduced;
        private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<FrameworkElement, object> styled = new ConditionalWeakTable<FrameworkElement, object>();
        private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<FrameworkElement, Action> updates = new ConditionalWeakTable<FrameworkElement, Action>();
        private static readonly List<WeakReference> surfaces = new List<WeakReference>();
        private static readonly Color Ink = Color.FromRgb(28, 42, 60);
        private static readonly Color Blue = Color.FromRgb(0, 99, 212);
        public static bool Reduced { get { return reduced || SystemParameters.HighContrast || RenderCapability.Tier < 0x20000; } }
        public static bool Animate { get { return SystemParameters.ClientAreaAnimation && !Reduced; } }
        internal static Grid Scene { get { return scene; } }

        public static void Install()
        {
            if (installed) return;
            installed = true;
            try {
                string path = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "PCL", "Fairylands-Glass.ini");
                reduced = File.Exists(path) && File.ReadAllText(path).Contains("ReduceTransparency=True");
                EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(FrameworkElement), FrameworkElement.LoadedEvent,
                    new RoutedEventHandler(OnLoaded), true);
                SystemParameters.StaticPropertyChanged += delegate { RefreshSurfaces(); };
                ClientPolicy.Initialize();
                UsageAnalytics.Initialize();
            } catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
        }

        // Invoked after the upstream theme refresh. Delay until its dispatcher work is finished.
        public static void Refresh()
        {
            if (Application.Current == null) return;
            Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, new Action(delegate {
                try { ApplyColors(); if (main != null) StyleWindow(main); RefreshSurfaces(); }
                catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
            }));
        }

        private static void Log(Exception e)
        {
            try {
                string dir = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "PCL");
                Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
                File.AppendAllText(System.IO.Path.Combine(dir, "Fairylands-Glass.log"),
                    DateTime.Now.ToString("s") + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message + Environment.NewLine);
            } catch { }
        }

        private static void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs args)
        {
            var element = sender as FrameworkElement;
            if (element == null) return;
            try {
                if (element.Name == "FairyUpdateStatus") {
                    ClientPolicy.BindStatus(element);
                    return;
                }
                var toggle = element as CheckBox;
                if (toggle != null && toggle.Name == "FairyUsageAnalytics") {
                    UsageAnalytics.Bind(toggle);
                    return;
                }
                if (toggle != null && toggle.Name == "FairyReduceTransparency") {
                    object exists;
                    if (styled.TryGetValue(toggle, out exists)) return;
                    styled.Add(toggle, new object());
                    toggle.IsChecked = reduced;
                    RoutedEventHandler change = delegate {
                        reduced = toggle.IsChecked == true;
                        try {
                            File.WriteAllText(System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "PCL", "Fairylands-Glass.ini"),
                                "ReduceTransparency=" + reduced + Environment.NewLine);
                        } catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
                        RefreshSurfaces();
                    };
                    toggle.Checked += change; toggle.Unchecked += change;
                    return;
                }
                if (element.GetType().Namespace != "PCL") return;
                string name = element.GetType().Name;
                if (name == "FormMain") {
                    main = element as Window;
                    main.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Loaded, new Action(delegate {
                        try { ApplyColors(); StyleWindow(main); Walk(main); } catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
                    }));
                    return;
                }
                Style(element);
            } catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
        }

        public static void RefreshElement(object instance)
        {
            try {
                var element = instance as FrameworkElement;
                Action update;
                if (element != null && updates.TryGetValue(element, out update)) update();
            } catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
        }

        private static void Walk(DependencyObject node)
        {
            var fe = node as FrameworkElement;
            if (fe != null && fe.GetType().Namespace == "PCL") Style(fe);
            for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(node); i++) Walk(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(node, i));
        }

        private static void Style(FrameworkElement element)
        {
            object already;
            if (styled.TryGetValue(element, out already)) return;
            string type = element.GetType().Name;
            if (type == "MyButton") StyleButton(element as Border);
            else if (type == "MyRadioButton") StyleRadio(element as Border);
            else if (type == "MyCard") {
                var grid = element as Grid;
                if (grid != null) foreach (UIElement child in grid.Children) {
                    var border = child as Border;
                    if (border != null) {
                        border.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(18);
                        border.Background = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(225, 255, 255, 255));
                        border.BorderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(40, 100, 130, 170));
                        border.BorderThickness = new Thickness(.7);
                    }
                }
                var radius = element.GetType().GetProperty("CornerRadius");
                if (radius != null) radius.SetValue(element, new CornerRadius(18), null);
            } else if (type == "MyTextBox") {
                var property = element.GetType().GetProperty("CornerRadius");
                if (property != null) property.SetValue(element, new CornerRadius(10), null);
            } else if (type == "MyComboBox") {
                var box = element as Control;
                if (box != null) {
                    box.ApplyTemplate();
                    var border = box.Template.FindName("border", box) as Border;
                    if (border != null) border.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(10);
                }
            } else if (type == "MyCheckBox") {
                var border = element.FindName("ShapeBorder") as Border;
                if (border != null) border.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(5);
            } else if (type == "MyListItem") {
                RoundBorders(element, 9);
            } else if (type == "PageLaunchLeft") {
                var launch = element.FindName("BtnLaunch") as FrameworkElement;
                var version = element.FindName("LabVersion") as TextBlock;
                if (launch != null) launch.Height = 60;
                if (version != null) {
                    Action updateVersion = delegate {
                        Hold(version, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty,
                            SystemParameters.HighContrast ? SystemColors.ControlTextBrush :
                            launch != null && launch.IsEnabled ? Brushes.White : new SolidColorBrush(Ink));
                    };
                    if (launch != null) launch.IsEnabledChanged += delegate { updateVersion(); };
                    updateVersion();
                    version.Opacity = .9;
                }
            } else if (type == "PageOtherAbout") {
                AddAttribution(element);
            } else return;
            styled.Add(element, new object());
        }

        private static void RoundBorders(DependencyObject node, double radius)
        {
            var border = node as Border;
            if (border != null && border.CornerRadius.TopLeft > 0) border.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(radius);
            for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(node); i++) RoundBorders(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(node, i), radius);
        }

        private static void ApplyColors()
        {
            if (Application.Current == null) return;
            string[] keys = { "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8" };
            string[] colors = { "#1C2A3C", "#0063D4", "#1675E5", "#659AE1", "#ACC8ED", "#DDE9F8", "#EDF3FB", "#F7FAFF" };
            for (int i = 0; i < keys.Length; i++) {
                Color c = (Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(colors[i]);
                Application.Current.Resources["ColorBrush" + keys[i]] = new SolidColorBrush(c);
                Application.Current.Resources["ColorObject" + keys[i]] = c;
            }
            Application.Current.Resources["ColorBrushBackgroundTransparentSidebar"] = Brushes.Transparent;
        }

        private static void StyleWindow(Window window)
        {
            if (window == null) return;
            window.Title = "PCL Fairylands 第三方美化版";
            window.FontFamily = new FontFamily("Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei UI");
            window.UseLayoutRounding = true;
            TextOptions.SetTextFormattingMode(window, TextFormattingMode.Display);
            var form = window.FindName("PanForm") as Grid;
            var title = window.FindName("PanTitle") as Grid;
            var left = window.FindName("PanLeft") as Grid;
            if (form == null || title == null || left == null) return;
            Hold(form, Panel.BackgroundProperty, new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(239, 245, 252)));
            Hold(title, Panel.BackgroundProperty, Brushes.Transparent);
            var clip = window.FindName("RectForm") as RectangleGeometry;
            if (clip != null && !clip.IsFrozen) { clip.RadiusX = 18; clip.RadiusY = 18; }
            var rotation = window.FindName("TransformRotate") as RotateTransform;
            if (rotation != null) rotation.BeginAnimation(RotateTransform.AngleProperty, new DoubleAnimation(0, TimeSpan.Zero));
            var position = window.FindName("TransformPos") as TranslateTransform;
            if (position != null) position.BeginAnimation(TranslateTransform.YProperty, new DoubleAnimation(0, TimeSpan.Zero));
            if (scene == null) {
                // The upstream resize grips paint square/13px shadows outside the
                // window clip. Keep their hit regions, but use one matching round shadow.
                foreach (string name in new[] { "ResizerT", "ResizerB", "ResizerL", "ResizerR",
                                               "ResizerLT", "ResizerRT", "ResizerLB", "ResizerRB" }) {
                    var grip = window.FindName(name) as Shape;
                    if (grip != null) Hold(grip, Shape.FillProperty, Brushes.Transparent);
                }
                var frame = window.FindName("BorderForm") as Border;
                var outer = frame == null ? null : frame.Parent as Panel;
                if (outer != null) {
                    var frameShadow = new Border {
                        Margin = frame.Margin, CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(18),
                        Background = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(239, 245, 252)),
                        IsHitTestVisible = false,
                        Effect = new DropShadowEffect { BlurRadius = 12, ShadowDepth = 1, Opacity = .14, Color = Colors.Black }
                    };
                    outer.Children.Insert(0, frameShadow);
                }
                scene = CreateScene();
                Grid.SetRowSpan(scene, 2);
                form.Children.Insert(0, scene);
                var topGlass = new GlassSurface(0, false);
                Grid.SetColumnSpan(topGlass, 10);
                title.Children.Insert(0, topGlass);
                var leftGlass = new GlassSurface(0, false);
                leftGlass.TintOpacity = .70;
                left.Children.Insert(0, leftGlass);
                var originalLeft = window.FindName("RectLeftBackground") as FrameworkElement;
                if (originalLeft != null)
                    leftGlass.SetBinding(FrameworkElement.WidthProperty,
                        new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ActualWidth") { Source = originalLeft });
                var titleLabel = window.FindName("LabTitleLogo") as TextBlock;
                if (titleLabel != null) Hold(titleLabel, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Visibility.Collapsed);
                var titleLogo = window.FindName("ShapeTitleLogo") as Shape;
                if (titleLogo != null) Hold(titleLogo, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Visibility.Collapsed);
                var originalLogo = window.FindName("ImageTitleLogo") as UIElement;
                if (originalLogo != null) Hold(originalLogo, UIElement.VisibilityProperty, Visibility.Collapsed);
                var titleMain = window.FindName("PanTitleMain") as Grid;
                string logoPath = System.IO.Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "PCL", "Fairylands.png");
                if (titleMain != null && File.Exists(logoPath)) {
                    var bitmap = new BitmapImage();
                    bitmap.BeginInit(); bitmap.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                    bitmap.UriSource = new Uri(logoPath); bitmap.EndInit(); bitmap.Freeze();
                    var logo = new Border {
                        Width = 100, Height = 40, Margin = new Thickness(16, 0, 0, 0),
                        HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center,
                        IsHitTestVisible = false,
                        Background = new ImageBrush(bitmap) { Viewbox = new Rect(16, 152, 480, 192), ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute, Stretch = Stretch.Uniform }
                    };
                    RenderOptions.SetBitmapScalingMode(logo, BitmapScalingMode.HighQuality);
                    titleMain.Children.Add(logo);
                    window.Icon = BitmapFrame.Create(bitmap);
                }
                var inner = window.FindName("LabTitleInner") as TextBlock;
                if (inner != null) Hold(inner, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, new SolidColorBrush(Ink));
                foreach (string name in new[] { "BtnTitleClose", "BtnTitleMin", "BtnTitleInner", "BtnTitleSelect" }) {
                    var icon = window.FindName(name) as FrameworkElement;
                    if (icon != null) DarkenIcons(icon);
                }
                // Remove the original dark separator; the translucent sidebar supplies the hierarchy.
                var shadow = window.FindName("RectLeftShadow") as UIElement;
                if (shadow != null) shadow.Opacity = .2;
            }
        }

        private static Grid CreateScene()
        {
            var grid = new Grid { IsHitTestVisible = false, ClipToBounds = true };
            grid.Background = new LinearGradientBrush(Color.FromRgb(235, 243, 253), Color.FromRgb(246, 248, 252), 65);
            grid.Children.Add(new Rectangle {
                Fill = new RadialGradientBrush {
                    Center = new Point(.05, .12), GradientOrigin = new Point(.05, .12), RadiusX = .8, RadiusY = .9,
                    GradientStops = new GradientStopCollection {
                        new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(95, 125, 177, 238), 0),
                        new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, 125, 177, 238), 1)
                    }
                }
            });
            grid.Children.Add(new Rectangle {
                Fill = new RadialGradientBrush {
                    Center = new Point(.95, .85), GradientOrigin = new Point(.95, .85), RadiusX = .7, RadiusY = .8,
                    GradientStops = new GradientStopCollection {
                        new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(65, 177, 210, 243), 0),
                        new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, 177, 210, 243), 1)
                    }
                }
            });
            return grid;
        }

        private static void DarkenIcons(DependencyObject root)
        {
            var path = root as System.Windows.Shapes.Path;
            if (path != null) Hold(path, Shape.FillProperty, new SolidColorBrush(Ink));
            for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(root); i++) DarkenIcons(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(root, i));
        }

        private static int EnumValue(object target, string property)
        {
            var p = target.GetType().GetProperty(property);
            return p == null ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(p.GetValue(target, null));
        }
        private static bool BoolValue(object target, string property)
        {
            var p = target.GetType().GetProperty(property);
            return p != null && true.Equals(p.GetValue(target, null));
        }

        private static void StyleButton(Border button)
        {
            if (button == null) return;
            var fore = button.FindName("PanFore") as Border;
            var text = button.FindName("LabText") as TextBlock;
            if (fore == null || text == null || !(fore.Child is UIElement)) return;
            var content = fore.Child;
            var padding = fore.Padding;
            fore.Child = null;
            fore.Padding = new Thickness(0);
            bool primary = EnumValue(button, "ColorType") == 1;
            var glass = new GlassSurface(12, primary);
            var materialScale = new ScaleTransform(1, 1);
            glass.RenderTransform = materialScale;
            glass.RenderTransformOrigin = new Point(.5, .5);
            var host = new Grid();
            host.Children.Add(glass);
            host.Children.Add(new Border { Padding = padding, Child = content });
            fore.Child = host;
            fore.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12);
            fore.BorderThickness = new Thickness(0);
            // Keep the rectangular click target transparent when the visible face scales.
            Hold(button, Border.BackgroundProperty, Brushes.Transparent);
            button.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12);
            var faceClip = new RectangleGeometry { RadiusX = 12, RadiusY = 12 };
            fore.Clip = faceClip;
            Action resizeClip = delegate { faceClip.Rect = new Rect(fore.RenderSize); };
            fore.SizeChanged += delegate { resizeClip(); };
            resizeClip();
            Hold(fore, Border.BackgroundProperty, Brushes.Transparent);
            Hold(fore, Border.BorderBrushProperty, Brushes.Transparent);
            System.Windows.Data.BindingOperations.ClearBinding(text, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty);
            text.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold;
            // Keep native text, launch progress, handlers, commands and click routing intact.
            button.SetBinding(AutomationProperties.NameProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding("Text") { Source = button });
            bool pressed = false;
            Action update = delegate {
                bool active = button.IsEnabled;
                primary = EnumValue(button, "ColorType") == 1;
                glass.Primary = primary;
                glass.Danger = EnumValue(button, "ColorType") == 2;
                glass.Update(button.IsMouseOver, button.IsKeyboardFocusWithin, pressed, !active);
                var color = !active ? Color.FromRgb(120, 133, 150) : primary ? Colors.White : glass.Danger ? Color.FromRgb(174, 48, 53) : Ink;
                Hold(text, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, new SolidColorBrush(SystemParameters.HighContrast ? SystemColors.ControlTextColor : color));
                var transform = fore.RenderTransform as ScaleTransform;
                if (transform != null) {
                    // Keep glyphs at their native size; animate only the material surface.
                    Ease(transform, ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, 1, 0);
                    Ease(transform, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, 1, 0);
                }
                Ease(materialScale, ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty, pressed && active && Animate ? .985 : 1, .18);
                Ease(materialScale, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty, pressed && active && Animate ? .985 : 1, .18);
            };
            button.MouseEnter += delegate { update(); };
            button.MouseLeave += delegate { pressed = false; update(); };
            button.MouseLeftButtonDown += delegate { pressed = true; update(); };
            button.MouseLeftButtonUp += delegate { pressed = false; update(); };
            button.GotKeyboardFocus += delegate { update(); };
            button.LostKeyboardFocus += delegate { pressed = false; update(); };
            button.IsEnabledChanged += delegate { pressed = false; update(); };
            button.PreviewKeyDown += delegate(object s, KeyEventArgs e) {
                if ((e.Key == Key.Enter || e.Key == Key.Space) && !e.IsRepeat && button.IsEnabled) { pressed = true; update(); e.Handled = true; }
            };
            button.PreviewKeyUp += delegate(object s, KeyEventArgs e) {
                if ((e.Key != Key.Enter && e.Key != Key.Space) || !pressed) return;
                pressed = false; update(); e.Handled = true;
                if (button.IsEnabled && button.IsVisible && button.IsKeyboardFocused) ClickNativeButton(button);
            };
            updates.Add(button, update);
            update();
        }

        private static void ClickNativeButton(Border button)
        {
            try {
                var flags = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
                var down = button.GetType().GetMethod("Button_MouseDown", flags, null, new[] { typeof(object), typeof(MouseButtonEventArgs) }, null);
                var up = button.GetType().GetMethod("Button_MouseUp", flags, null, new[] { typeof(object), typeof(MouseButtonEventArgs) }, null);
                var reset = button.GetType().GetMethod("Button_MouseUp", flags, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
                if (down == null || up == null || reset == null) return;
                var args = new MouseButtonEventArgs(Mouse.PrimaryDevice, Environment.TickCount, MouseButton.Left) { Source = button };
                down.Invoke(button, new object[] { button, args });
                try { up.Invoke(button, new object[] { button, args }); }
                finally { reset.Invoke(button, null); }
            } catch (Exception e) { Log(e); }
        }

        private static void StyleRadio(Border radio)
        {
            if (radio == null) return;
            radio.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(13);
            var text = radio.FindName("LabText") as TextBlock;
            var icon = radio.FindName("ShapeLogo") as Shape;
            Action update = delegate {
                bool selected = BoolValue(radio, "Checked");
                Color foreground = selected ? Blue : Ink;
                Hold(radio, Border.BackgroundProperty, new SolidColorBrush(selected ? Colors.White : radio.IsMouseOver ? Color.FromArgb(95, 255, 255, 255) : Colors.Transparent));
                if (text != null) Hold(text, TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, new SolidColorBrush(foreground));
                if (icon != null) Hold(icon, Shape.FillProperty, new SolidColorBrush(foreground));
                radio.BorderThickness = new Thickness(selected ? .7 : 0);
                radio.BorderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(60, 90, 127, 170));
            };
            radio.MouseEnter += delegate { update(); };
            radio.MouseLeave += delegate { update(); };
            radio.MouseLeftButtonUp += delegate { radio.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.DataBind, update); };
            updates.Add(radio, update);
            update();
        }

        private static void AddAttribution(FrameworkElement page)
        {
            var panel = FindPanel(page);
            if (panel == null) return;
            var attribution = new TextBlock {
                Text = "PCL 原作者：龙腾猫跃\nPCL Fairylands 第三方美化版 · 非官方版本",
                Foreground = new SolidColorBrush(Ink), TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 16), FontSize = 13
            };
            var link = new System.Windows.Documents.Hyperlink(new System.Windows.Documents.Run("赞助 PCL 原作者")) { NavigateUri = new Uri("https://meloong.com/afd/a/LTCat") };
            link.RequestNavigate += delegate(object sender, System.Windows.Navigation.RequestNavigateEventArgs e) {
                System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(e.Uri.AbsoluteUri) { UseShellExecute = true });
                e.Handled = true;
            };
            attribution.Inlines.Add(new System.Windows.Documents.LineBreak());
            attribution.Inlines.Add(link);
            panel.Children.Insert(0, attribution);
        }
        private static StackPanel FindPanel(DependencyObject root)
        {
            var panel = root as StackPanel;
            if (panel != null) return panel;
            for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(root); i++) {
                var found = FindPanel(VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(root, i));
                if (found != null) return found;
            }
            return null;
        }

        internal static void Register(GlassSurface surface) { surfaces.Add(new WeakReference(surface)); }
        private static void RefreshSurfaces()
        {
            if (Application.Current != null && !Application.Current.Dispatcher.CheckAccess()) {
                Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(RefreshSurfaces));
                return;
            }
            for (int i = surfaces.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                var surface = surfaces[i].Target as GlassSurface;
                if (surface == null) surfaces.RemoveAt(i); else surface.RefreshQuality();
            }
        }
        internal static void Hold(DependencyObject obj, DependencyProperty property, object value)
        {
            var timeline = new ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames { Duration = TimeSpan.Zero, FillBehavior = FillBehavior.HoldEnd };
            timeline.KeyFrames.Add(new DiscreteObjectKeyFrame(value, KeyTime.FromTimeSpan(TimeSpan.Zero)));
            var element = obj as UIElement;
            if (element != null) element.BeginAnimation(property, timeline);
            else {
                var content = obj as ContentElement;
                if (content != null) content.BeginAnimation(property, timeline);
            }
        }
        internal static void Ease(Animatable obj, DependencyProperty property, double to, double seconds)
        {
            obj.BeginAnimation(property, new DoubleAnimation(to, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Animate ? seconds : 0)) {
                EasingFunction = new CubicEase { EasingMode = EasingMode.EaseOut }
            });
        }
    }

    internal sealed class GlassSurface : Grid
    {
        private readonly Rectangle backdrop;
        private readonly Border tint, rim, focus;
        private readonly SolidColorBrush tintBrush;
        private readonly RectangleGeometry clip;
        private VisualBrush sample;
        private Rect sampledRect;
        private readonly double radius;
        private bool hover, focused, pressed, disabled;
        public bool Primary, Danger;
        public double TintOpacity = .66;
        public GlassSurface(double radius, bool primary)
        {
            this.radius = radius; Primary = primary;
            IsHitTestVisible = false;
            clip = new RectangleGeometry { RadiusX = radius, RadiusY = radius };
            Clip = clip;
            backdrop = new Rectangle { IsHitTestVisible = false };
            tintBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.White);
            tint = new Border { Background = tintBrush, CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(radius) };
            rim = new Border {
                CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(radius), BorderThickness = new Thickness(1),
                BorderBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(Color.FromArgb(230, 255, 255, 255), Color.FromArgb(36, 88, 118, 160), 90)
            };
            focus = new Border { CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(radius), BorderThickness = new Thickness(2), BorderBrush = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0, 99, 212)), Opacity = 0 };
            Children.Add(backdrop); Children.Add(tint); Children.Add(rim); Children.Add(focus);
            Loaded += delegate { RefreshQuality(); UpdateSample(); };
            SizeChanged += delegate { clip.Rect = new Rect(RenderSize); UpdateSample(); };
            LayoutUpdated += delegate { if (IsVisible) UpdateSample(); };
            GlassTheme.Register(this);
            RefreshQuality();
        }
        private void UpdateSample()
        {
            if (GlassTheme.Reduced || GlassTheme.Scene == null || !IsLoaded || ActualWidth <= 0 || ActualHeight <= 0) return;
            try {
                Point p = TranslatePoint(new Point(0, 0), GlassTheme.Scene);
                Rect next = new Rect(p, RenderSize);
                if (sample != null && next == sampledRect) return;
                if (sample == null) {
                    sample = new VisualBrush(GlassTheme.Scene) { ViewboxUnits = BrushMappingMode.Absolute, Stretch = Stretch.Fill, AlignmentX = AlignmentX.Left, AlignmentY = AlignmentY.Top };
                    backdrop.Fill = sample;
                }
                sample.Viewbox = next;
                sampledRect = next;
            } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
        }
        public void RefreshQuality()
        {
            backdrop.Visibility = GlassTheme.Reduced ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
            backdrop.Effect = GlassTheme.Reduced ? null : new BlurEffect { Radius = 6, RenderingBias = RenderingBias.Performance };
            Update(hover, focused, pressed, disabled);
        }
        public void Update(bool hover, bool focused, bool pressed, bool disabled)
        {
            this.hover = hover; this.focused = focused; this.pressed = pressed; this.disabled = disabled;
            Color color;
            if (SystemParameters.HighContrast) color = SystemColors.ControlColor;
            else if (disabled) color = Color.FromArgb(235, 228, 234, 242);
            else if (Primary) color = pressed ? Color.FromArgb(250, 0, 83, 183) : hover ? Color.FromArgb(245, 12, 111, 226) : Color.FromArgb(245, 0, 99, 212);
            else color = Color.FromArgb((byte)(GlassTheme.Reduced ? 255 : pressed ? 235 : hover ? 225 : 255 * TintOpacity), 255, 255, 255);
            tintBrush.BeginAnimation(SolidColorBrush.ColorProperty, new ColorAnimation(color, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(GlassTheme.Animate ? .18 : 0)));
            focus.Opacity = focused && !disabled ? 1 : 0;
            rim.Opacity = disabled ? .45 : 1;
        }
    }
}

《PCL 存储库合理使用指南》



本指南仅作为说明，不是法律文件或协议。

除《PCL 分发有限许可》明确授予的权利外，开发者保留软件及其相关知识产权中的全部权利。但开发者承诺，在遵守本指南，且善意、合理使用的情况下，不会追究责任。



一、轻度使用



若您仅参考了本存储库中极小部分的内容，或您在制作与 PCL 的实质功能不存在任何重叠的软件，则为轻度使用。

其常见情形例如：

· 使用或参考存储库中极小部分的内容，来开发启动器或其他软件。

· 虽参考了较大量的内容，但制作的软件与 PCL 的实质功能不存在任何重叠。



若属于轻度使用，您需要：

1、以适当的形式给出署名。

2、不得将您的内容与 PCL 混淆，或暗示您的内容与 PCL 有关。

 　例如：您的内容不得使用 Potato Craft Launcher、PCL 手机版 等会造成混淆或暗示这与 PCL 有关的名称。



二、重度使用



若不符合轻度使用的情形，即为重度使用。

其常见情形例如：

· 基于本存储库进行修改。

· 参考存储库中较大量的内容，以制作或重新实现 PCL 的部分实质功能（例如启动或下载 Java 版 Minecraft，下载或管理 Mod 等）。



若属于重度使用，您需要：

1、明确表示您的内容是第三方基于 PCL 独立进行二次创作的产物。

2、您的内容的名称必须以 Plain Craft Launcher (PCL) 开头，并在其后添加足以表现其由第三方修改的后缀。

 　允许的示例：PCL 某服务器魔改版、PCL PR Collection、PCL (XX Bug Fix)、PCL XXX修改版。

 　禁止的示例：PCL 某服务器特供版（暗示由官方提供）、PCL 3、PCL 手机版、PCL++、PCL Pro（这像是官方的后续作品）。

3、在关于页面的首位给出龙腾猫跃的署名及对应的赞助链接，公开源代码，且继续使用本文件作为指南（可参考 CC BY-SA 协议）。

4、软件若有 Minecraft 启动功能，则应实现与 McLaunchPrecheck 函数一致（或更激进）的 Minecraft 正版购买劝导与赞助劝导。

5、软件在 Windows 系统上运行时，不应有与 PCL 的赞助解锁功能类似的功能或表现。

 　例如：界面的主要色相必须为蓝色（即使没有修改功能，改为其他色相也和需要赞助解锁的主题功能类似）。



————————————————————————————————————



说人话的备注：



这些规则主要是为了阻止恶意的使用、倒卖和 “山寨版” 的出现，常规、善意的使用都没啥问题的，放心吧！



如果你只是参考了一小段代码，署个名就行啦，不用担心。

如果对具体细节有疑问，或是希望修改这些规则，欢迎在 https://github.com/Meloong-Git/PCL/discussions/new?category=%E6%8F%90%E9%97%AE 发帖！



多谢大家啦！
PCL-Glass-source/README.txt

保存原文件

PCL Fairylands 第三方美化版 · Glass



PCL 原作者：龙腾猫跃

赞助原作者：https://meloong.com/afd/a/LTCat

上游：https://github.com/Meloong-Git/PCL/tree/2.99.0.0

上游源码提交：6b9a50d（2.99.0.0）

本项目是 Fairylands 独立制作的第三方界面修改，不是 PCL 官方版本。

继续使用本目录 LICENCE 作为指南；原作者信息、购买提示与赞助功能保留。



文件

GlassTheme.cs：Windows WPF 界面主题，圆角、窗口内背景取样模糊与交互过渡。

ApplyTheme.cs：使用 Mono.Cecil 加入界面回调和明确的下载/安装/启动策略。

ClientPolicy.cs：仅允许 1.21.11、26.2、26.3 的配套 NeoForge，校验签名更新清单并按需更新 Mod。

update-public-key.xml、update-baseline.json：公开验签材料；不包含签名私钥。

DESIGN.md：设计依据、交互参数和实现边界。

branding/Custom-Glass.xaml：简洁首页。

tools/build_pcl_glass.ps1：编译并装配界面，绝不运行启动器。



登录

原始 PCL 的离线用户名和微软账号登录代码继续使用，不替换认证流程。

无任何预填账号、密码、令牌，也没有复制或要求用户提供 OAuth 应用密钥。

服务器是否允许对应账号进入，仍由 fairymc.cn 的服务端配置决定。

未运行客户端验证微软登录或离线登录。



构建

使用完整的 FairyClient-1.2.6-Glass-source-project.zip 解压后的项目目录。

Windows 需安装 .NET Framework 4.8；脚本使用系统自带的 Framework C# 编译器和 WPF 库。

源码包包含固定输入 downloads/PCL-binary/Plain Craft Launcher 2.exe。

构建依赖 Mono.Cecil 0.11.6：downloads/cecil/lib/net40/Mono.Cecil.dll。

原始 NuGet 包一并提供；来源：

https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/mono.cecil/0.11.6/mono.cecil.0.11.6.nupkg

Mono.Cecil 源码与 MIT 许可：https://github.com/jbevain/cecil



在项目根目录执行：

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/build_pcl_glass.ps1



输出位于 build/pcl-glass：

PCL-Fairylands.exe

Fairylands.PclGlass.dll



两者必须放在同一个目录。原始官方输入始终保留，不覆盖。

构建工具比较未修改核心方法的指令摘要，排除明确加入的两个启动策略回调；报告写入 audit/pcl-glass-hooks.txt。

该检查是静态文件核对，不代表运行兼容性测试。

源码包中的 Python 组装工具还需要既有游戏、模组下载和 Java 运行时输入；

重建启动器本身不需要重新编译或下载 Minecraft。



使用

玩家整包解压后打开 PCL-Fairylands.exe，选择离线用户名或微软账号。

PCL 首页“常用操作”提供“减少毛玻璃效果”，设置保存在 PCL/Fairylands-Glass.ini。

本主题使用窗口内背景模糊，不是 Apple 原生 Liquid Glass，也不采集桌面画面。

原始官方 EXE 只作为固定构建输入保留；玩家整包使用专属启动器执行版本和必需 Mod 检查。

PCL 自身更新关闭（PCL/Setup.ini：SystemSystemUpdate:3）；Fairylands Mod 更新独立进行。

下载列表固定为 1.21.11、26.2、26.3；其他版本、加载器和手动原版下载不开放。

1.2.4 修复下载页初始化：使用共享 Minecraft 版本列表加载器，保留页面重试与完成回调。

构建时核对最终 EXE 中的加载器引用，避免占位任务在显示专属版本列表前报错。

1.2.6 更新签名基线，自动补齐带窗口图标和专服限制的 1.2.6 Mod；服务端指纹需同步更新。

删除必需 Mod 后先自动修复，修复失败停止启动；已有完整签名版本可在更新源不可达时启动。

启动画面使用原始 Fairylands PNG 和 PCL 原有的 400 ms 渐隐，不再展示原 PCL 启动图。

1.2.2 同步窗口圆角阴影和按钮裁切；按钮文字不参与缩放，背景表面单独动画。

本次按照用户要求只编译和检查文件，未启动 PCL、游戏或服务器测试。

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Web.Script.Serialization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace Fairylands.PclGlass
{
    // Optional launcher metrics. No game/account APIs, hardware identifiers or admin credentials.
    internal static class UsageAnalytics
    {
        private static readonly object Sync = new object();
        private static Timer timer;
        private static HttpWebRequest request;
        private static bool initialized, enabled, busy, started;
        private static int generation;
        private static string installation, settings;
        private static readonly string Session = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        private static Uri endpoint;
        public sealed class Preference { public bool enabled; public string installation; public string endpoint; }

        public static void Initialize()
        {
            lock (Sync) {
                if (initialized) return;
                initialized = true;
                try {
                    if (!Uri.TryCreate(AnalyticsBuild.Endpoint, UriKind.Absolute, out endpoint) ||
                        endpoint.Scheme != "https" || endpoint.AbsolutePath != "/v1/events" ||
                        endpoint.UserInfo.Length != 0 || endpoint.Query.Length != 0 || endpoint.Fragment.Length != 0) {
                        endpoint = null; return;
                    }
                    string key;
                    using (var sha = SHA256.Create()) key = BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(
                        Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory.ToUpperInvariant()))).Replace("-", "");
                    settings = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
                        "Fairylands", "Analytics", key + ".json");
                    if (File.Exists(settings)) {
                        var state = new JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize<Preference>(File.ReadAllText(settings));
                        Guid id;
                        if (state != null && Guid.TryParseExact(state.installation, "N", out id)) {
                            installation = id.ToString("N");
                            enabled = state.enabled && state.endpoint == endpoint.AbsoluteUri;
                        }
                    }
                    if (enabled) Start();
                } catch { enabled = false; }
            }
        }

        public static void Bind(CheckBox toggle)
        {
            if (toggle.Tag is string && (string)toggle.Tag == "FairyAnalyticsBound") return;
            toggle.Tag = "FairyAnalyticsBound";
            Initialize();
            toggle.IsEnabled = endpoint != null;
            toggle.IsChecked = enabled;
            toggle.Content = endpoint == null ? "使用统计尚未配置" : "参与匿名启动器使用统计（可随时关闭）";
            toggle.ToolTip = endpoint == null ? "当前版本没有统计接收地址，不会上报数据。" :
                "发送至 " + endpoint.Host + "；仅发送随机安装标识、会话标识、启动器版本及启动/活跃事件。" +
                "不发送账号、聊天、存档或硬件标识。数据保留 90 天；服务端连接会接触 IP，但统计库不保存 IP。";
            bool changing = false;
            RoutedEventHandler change = delegate {
                if (changing) return;
                bool next = toggle.IsChecked == true;
                lock (Sync) {
                    enabled = false; generation++;
                    if (timer != null) { timer.Dispose(); timer = null; }
                    if (request != null) request.Abort();
                    try {
                        if (installation == null) installation = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(settings));
                        string temp = settings + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
                        try {
                            File.WriteAllText(temp, new JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(new Preference {
                                enabled = next, installation = installation, endpoint = endpoint.AbsoluteUri
                            }), Encoding.UTF8);
                            if (File.Exists(settings)) File.Replace(temp, settings, null);
                            else File.Move(temp, settings);
                        } finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
                        enabled = next;
                        if (enabled) Start();
                    } catch {
                        MessageBox.Show("无法保存统计偏好，本次上报已停止。请检查本机用户目录权限。", "Fairylands");
                    }
                }
                changing = true;
                try { toggle.IsChecked = enabled; } finally { changing = false; }
            };
            toggle.Checked += change; toggle.Unchecked += change;
        }

        private static void Start()
        {
            // A failed request retries at the next interval; never delays the UI or game launch.
            timer = new Timer(Send, null, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
        }

        private static void Send(object ignored)
        {
            HttpWebRequest pending;
            byte[] body;
            int epoch;
            lock (Sync) {
                if (!enabled || busy || endpoint == null) return;
                busy = true; epoch = generation;
                try {
                    pending = (HttpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create(endpoint);
                    pending.Method = "POST"; pending.ContentType = "application/json";
                    pending.AllowAutoRedirect = false; pending.Timeout = 5000; pending.ReadWriteTimeout = 5000;
                    pending.UserAgent = "FairyClient-Usage/1";
                    pending.UseDefaultCredentials = false;
                    body = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(new JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(new {
                        schema = 1, installation = installation, session = Session,
                        version = AnalyticsBuild.Version, kind = started ? "active" : "start"
                    }));
                    pending.ContentLength = body.Length;
                    request = pending;
                } catch { busy = false; return; }
            }
            try {
                using (var deadline = new Timer(delegate { try { pending.Abort(); } catch { } }, null, 6000, Timeout.Infinite)) {
                    using (var stream = pending.GetRequestStream()) stream.Write(body, 0, body.Length);
                    using (var response = (HttpWebResponse)pending.GetResponse()) {
                        lock (Sync) if (generation == epoch && response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.NoContent) started = true;
                    }
                }
            } catch { /* Offline statistics never prevent playing. */ }
            finally { lock (Sync) { request = null; busy = false; } }
        }
    }
}

《PCL 存储库合理使用指南》



本指南仅作为说明，不是法律文件或协议。

除《PCL 分发有限许可》明确授予的权利外，开发者保留软件及其相关知识产权中的全部权利。但开发者承诺，在遵守本指南，且善意、合理使用的情况下，不会追究责任。



一、轻度使用



若您仅参考了本存储库中极小部分的内容，或您在制作与 PCL 的实质功能不存在任何重叠的软件，则为轻度使用。

其常见情形例如：

· 使用或参考存储库中极小部分的内容，来开发启动器或其他软件。

· 虽参考了较大量的内容，但制作的软件与 PCL 的实质功能不存在任何重叠。



若属于轻度使用，您需要：

1、以适当的形式给出署名。

2、不得将您的内容与 PCL 混淆，或暗示您的内容与 PCL 有关。

 　例如：您的内容不得使用 Potato Craft Launcher、PCL 手机版 等会造成混淆或暗示这与 PCL 有关的名称。



二、重度使用



若不符合轻度使用的情形，即为重度使用。

其常见情形例如：

· 基于本存储库进行修改。

· 参考存储库中较大量的内容，以制作或重新实现 PCL 的部分实质功能（例如启动或下载 Java 版 Minecraft，下载或管理 Mod 等）。



若属于重度使用，您需要：

1、明确表示您的内容是第三方基于 PCL 独立进行二次创作的产物。

2、您的内容的名称必须以 Plain Craft Launcher (PCL) 开头，并在其后添加足以表现其由第三方修改的后缀。

 　允许的示例：PCL 某服务器魔改版、PCL PR Collection、PCL (XX Bug Fix)、PCL XXX修改版。

 　禁止的示例：PCL 某服务器特供版（暗示由官方提供）、PCL 3、PCL 手机版、PCL++、PCL Pro（这像是官方的后续作品）。

3、在关于页面的首位给出龙腾猫跃的署名及对应的赞助链接，公开源代码，且继续使用本文件作为指南（可参考 CC BY-SA 协议）。

4、软件若有 Minecraft 启动功能，则应实现与 McLaunchPrecheck 函数一致（或更激进）的 Minecraft 正版购买劝导与赞助劝导。

5、软件在 Windows 系统上运行时，不应有与 PCL 的赞助解锁功能类似的功能或表现。

 　例如：界面的主要色相必须为蓝色（即使没有修改功能，改为其他色相也和需要赞助解锁的主题功能类似）。



————————————————————————————————————



说人话的备注：



这些规则主要是为了阻止恶意的使用、倒卖和 “山寨版” 的出现，常规、善意的使用都没啥问题的，放心吧！



如果你只是参考了一小段代码，署个名就行啦，不用担心。

如果对具体细节有疑问，或是希望修改这些规则，欢迎在 https://github.com/Meloong-Git/PCL/discussions/new?category=%E6%8F%90%E9%97%AE 发帖！



多谢大家啦！
